findings.text: The company was incorporated on 1 April 2022 and currently holds 'active' status.
There is one current director, PERSON 242, who was appointed on 1 April 2022 and has no other recorded appointments.
PERSON 243 is the sole person with significant control, holding between 75 and 100 percent of shares and voting rights, and the right to appoint and remove directors.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last accounts made up to 31 March 2025 and the next due on 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the last statement made up to 31 March 2026 and the next due on 14 April 2027.
No charges are registered against the company and no insolvency record is held for it.
There have been no changes to the registered office address or officer appointments since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 292 is an active company incorporated in 2022 with no insolvency records, no registered charges, and up-to-date statutory filings.
